purpose: Evaluate whether a past-only, per-recipe scalar decision threshold transfers on saved OOF predictions from the exact current MIX50 policy.

scope.test_probability_access: Only after the final OOF threshold receipt is durably created and source/input hashes match.

current_formula.current_missing_decision: existing MIX50 label, equivalent to pP >= 0.50

metric.selection_objective: overall binary Macro F1 on the complete selector rows, with missing outputs fixed to the existing MIX50 >= 0.50 decision
metric.decision_comparison: selected threshold versus 0.50 on identical later rows
metric.ties: If objective values are within 1e-12 of the maximum, choose the candidate closest to 0.50, then the lower candidate threshold.

threshold_candidates.construction: All positive/negative allocations reachable without splitting equal-probability ties: 0.0, the fixed 0.50, one safe cutpoint between every adjacent distinct present probability, and nextafter(1.0, +infinity) for all-negative allocation. If a midpoint is not strictly between adjacent float scores, use the upper distinct score.

support.fallback_status: FIXED_0_50_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT; no learned decision selection counted

selection_stages.model_origin_note: Same base model origin; E67 fit boundary is cycle 67.
Base model origin changes from fit-through-67 to fit-through-75; report as cross-origin transfer.

selection_stages.selection_origin: E67 MIX50 OOF predictions for cycles 68-75 plus E75 MIX50 OOF predictions for cycles 76-79
selection_stages.model_origin_note: Use E75 for cycles 76-79; do not include duplicate E67 W6 IDs.
selection_stages.final_use: Freeze this threshold and all input/source hashes before reading the E79 probability bundle or constructing an E79 CSV.

reporting.pooled_w5_w6: Use unique rows and pooled confusion counts; do not average the two window Macro F1 values.
reporting.secondary_comparators: POS and A02 at 0.50 only when aligned in the exact saved bundle; descriptive, not threshold-selected.
reporting.probability_metrics: Do not claim AUC, average precision, log loss, or Brier changes; probabilities are unchanged by thresholding.

durability_and_resume.prefit_commit_validation: The reviewed source commit must exist and be an ancestor of current HEAD. For script, protocol, tests, and src/models/research_next_contract.py, bind the on-disk file SHA-256 plus the Git blob OID and SHA-256 of committed blob bytes. Verify committed and current blobs still match; all other frozen source/input hashes must also match. Descendant report-only commits are allowed.
durability_and_resume.freeze_digest_contract: prefit_freeze_file_sha256 hashes the exact on-disk JSON bytes; prefit_freeze_receipt_sha256 is the canonical receipt_sha256 inside that JSON. They are distinct required approval fields.

resource_gate.estimate_note: Conservative incremental allowance for 20,903-row NumPy threshold arrays and line-streamed 50,608-row Train ID/label lookup; not a measured peak.
resource_gate.reservation_order: Check available RAM before appending RESERVE; a low-memory block leaves the selection ledger unchanged. Reuse of a complete durable receipt consumes no new selection or resource reservation.

durability_and_resume.immutable_receipts: Create with O_EXCL, flush and fsync. On selection resume, replay current IDs, cycles, probability/missing-mask hashes, source hashes, reservation ID, and recipe version against the receipt. Reuse only exact hash-bound receipts; never overwrite.
durability_and_resume.ledger: Separate append-only stage ledger; max three reservations. Each RESERVE has a canonical unique reservation_id and passing resource-gate receipt; COMPLETE must reference that reservation_id and the exact SHA-256 of the persisted selection receipt. Verify the complete-event digest on every resume. A reserved stage without its durable receipt blocks resume; do not repeat selection automatically.
durability_and_resume.evaluation_receipt_resume: Before reusing an evaluation receipt, verify evaluation ID, exact cycle values/range, row count, ordered record-ID digest, threshold receipt digest/value, frozen source hashes, current probability/missing/group input hashes, Train file hash, and target-label digest read only after the durable threshold receipt exists.
durability_and_resume.record_ids: Unicode arrays only; object arrays prohibited.
durability_and_resume.csv: One versioned local candidate at most; duplicate label-vector scan required. No upload by this script.

review_boundary: Do not run official selector stages until the root creates a matching ROOT_PREFIT_PASS.json after independent code and metric-boundary review. Validate the approval against the exact R5 freeze file/receipt digests and reviewed source commit; report-only commits may follow that source commit.
